summary.en: Violent clashes persist between the Viv Ansanm gangs and Haitian security forces, now reinforced by a Kenya-led multinational mission patrolling Port-au-Prince and Kenscoff. The Dominican army has supplied large ammunition stocks to the 400 Mawozo gang, increasing its firepower, while Taiwan has offered security experience sharing with Haiti. Mayor Jean Massillon of Kenscoff, who warned about gang violence, has died. The European Union provided four million euros for the PMSAN 2 Food Security Program, and the UCDP recorded 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Voldelige sammenstøt vedvarer mellom gjengene Viv Ansanm og haitiske sikkerhetsstyrker, nå forsterket av en Kenya-ledet multinasjonal styrke som patruljerer Port-au-Prince og Kenscoff. Den dominikanske hæren har levert store ammunisjonslagre til gjengen 400 Mawozo, noe som øker deres ildkraft, mens Taiwan har tilbudt sikkerhetserfaringsdeling med Haiti. Ordfører Jean Massillon i Kenscoff, som advarte om gjengvold, er død. Den europeiske unionen ga fire millioner euro til PMSAN‑2‑programmet for matsikkerhet, og UCDP registrerte 193 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict. The government of Haiti and Haitian security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
